text:
nico: quick follow-up from the postmortem retro: we need a lightweight, enforceable follow-up cadence so remediation items don't vanish. thinking checkpoints at 24h, 72h, and 7d plus a 30d recurrence audit.

emily: yup. prefer a tiny structured form we can paste into the postmortem. no freeform walls of text.

raj: ops load matters. template should be machine-readable fields only so automation can nudge and surface missing info. propose fields: checkpoint, owner, status, next_step, blocker, related_incidents_count.

olivia: can we add an "escalate_if" rule? e.g., if related_incidents_count >= 3 then auto-tag patterns and notify reliability lead.

sam: practical tracking: create a "Checkpoints" column on our incident board and require the owner to move the card at each checkpoint with a one-line comment. board move = traceable event.

oncall-bot: mock: will DM owner at 24h/72h/7d and post a checklist summary to the thread if owner doesn't update within 30m of reminder. automation PR required. :robot_face:

nico: simple pasteable template (one block):
```
Checkpoint: <24h|72h|7d|30d>
Owner: @<name>
Status: (Mitigating|Monitoring|Remediated)
Next step: <who + ETA>
Blocker: <person/reason>
Related incidents (90d): <n>
Board card: <link>
```

emily: rotation tweak: weekly incident commander rotation but add a "handoff ack" requirement when IC changes mid-incident. old IC posts `!handoff @newIC` which creates the mini-handoff card (3 bullets) and requires :white_check_mark: from the shadow.

raj: metrics to monitor in pilot: percent of postmortems missing 24h entry, percent of actions without owner after 72h, median time-to-remediation, recurrence escalation count. add to ops dashboard.

olivia: pilot plan idea: run with 5 teams for 6 weeks. success criteria: reduce stale-action rate by >40% and catch >=80% of recurring issues before they hit patterns board.

sam: i'll add the board lane and a policy note: cannot move PM to Closed without at least one 72h checkpoint entry with owner+ETA.

oncall-bot: placeholder saved: RFC-1958000000-checkpoint-cadence by nico.

nico: i'll write the RFC and include the template, bot tasks, and dashboard metrics. tagging sre + infra + platform. will aim to start pilot next sprint. thanks. :thumbsup:
